caseName: Blumenstock Bros. Advertising Agency v. Curtis Publishing Co.
caseNameFull: Blumenstock Brothers Advertising Agency v. Curtis Publishing Company

opinions.text: Error to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit. January 10, 1921. Dismissed with costs, on motion of counsel for plaintiff in error. Mr. Colin C. H. Fyffe for plaintiff in error. No appearance for defendant in error.
